column1: # Squirrel label bank, version 3 (LABELS_VERSION in src/clip/labels.rs).
# slug<TAB>English class names separated by |[<TAB>group]. Every name goes
# through every prompt template (src/clip/templates.rs); the label's embedding
# is their average. One label per concept: near-synonyms are names of one
# label, not labels competing with each other. Labels a photo is easily
# mistaken between (dog and cat, car and truck) share a group: only the best of
# a group can become a tag, and only by a clear margin over its siblings; a
# search close to a grouped label must beat that label's siblings too.
# Changing anything here means a new file and a new LABELS_VERSION.
